opportunities.name: Expedia rental car search by pick-up location, dates and times
opportunities.description: Search for a rental car on Expedia by choosing a pick-up location (with optional separate drop-off), pick-up and drop-off dates and times, then run the search and optionally sort the results.
steps: Open the Expedia home page and click the 'Cars' tab.
Click the 'Pick-up' field and type the pick-up city or airport code.
Choose the matching suggestion from the dropdown (e.g. the airport entry).
If the drop-off differs, click 'Same as pick-up' and type/choose the drop-off location; otherwise leave it.
Click the 'Pick-up date' button, navigate to the month if needed, click the start date, then click the end date in the calendar.
Click 'Done' to close the date picker.
Select the pick-up time and drop-off time from their dropdowns.
Click 'Search'.
Optionally change the 'Sort by' dropdown on the results page (e.g. 'Total Price').
parameters: pick-up location (city or airport, e.g. 'jfk', 'San Francisco')
drop-off location (same as pick-up or a different place)

instances.values: Pick-up JFK (typed 'jfk'), drop-off same as pick-up, Apr 5 to Apr 6, 10:30 am both times. Flow stopped after pick-up selection; no search run.
Pick-up and drop-off JFK, Apr 3 to Apr 6, pick-up 9:00 am, drop-off 6:00 pm, search run, sort changed to 'Total Price'.
Pick-up San Francisco (typed 'San Francisco', chose 'San Francisco, California'), pick-up date changed from Apr 2 to Apr 8, drop-off Apr 9, search run, filter by Economy/Avis applied on results.

opportunities.name: Booking.com flight search with airport/city, dates, passengers and fastest-flight booking
opportunities.description: Search for flights on Booking.com by choosing trip type, origin and destination airports, travel dates and passenger count, then pick the fastest flight and proceed through the ticket-type step.
steps: Open the Booking.com home page and click the 'Flights' tab.
Select the trip type (One way, Round trip or Multi-city).
Click the origin field, type the origin city or airport, and tick the matching suggestion.
Click the destination field, type the destination city or airport, and tick the matching suggestion (for multi-city, add legs as needed).
Click the departure date field and click the start date; for round trips click the return date too.
Set passengers via the adults dropdown and click 'Done'.
Optionally tick 'Direct flights only'.
Click 'Search'.
On results, click the 'Fastest' tab, then click 'See flight' on the first result and 'Select' in the fare dialog.
Click 'Next' on the ticket-type page.
parameters: destination city/airport (one per leg for multi-city)

instances.values: One way, Columbus typed 'banglore' then changed origin to BLR Bangalore, destination GOI Panaji (typed 'goa'), depart Mar 29 2023, 2 adults, direct only, Fastest, Standard ticket, Next.
Multi-city: New York -> Tokyo (TYO, June 1 2023) -> New Delhi (DEL, June 5 2023), 1 adult, direct only, Fastest, Standard ticket, Next.

opportunities.name: Carnival cruise search by destination, departure port, month and guests
opportunities.description: Search Carnival cruises by choosing a sail-to region, optional sail-from port, a departure month, and a guest count, then run the search.
opportunities.site: carnival.com (SHAQ promo page and results page)
steps: Click the 'Sail To' dropdown and click the destination region button (e.g. Panama Canal, Caribbean).
Optionally click 'Sail From' and click a departure port.
Optionally click 'Dates' and click the month/year cell.
Click 'SEARCH CRUISES'.
On the results page, click 'Number of Guests' and use + / - to set the count, then close the popup.

instances.values: Sail To Panama Canal, Sail From San Francisco CA, Dates October 2024, then search.
Sail To Caribbean, search, then guests set on results page from 2 to 3 to 4.

opportunities.name: MTA planned service changes lookup by route and date
opportunities.description: Look up planned service changes on the MTA site by typing a route name, selecting it, optionally picking a date, and reviewing results.
steps: Open the MTA site and click 'Planned Work' (or 'Planned Service Changes' from the menu).
Click the 'Search Routes' box and type the route name (e.g. 'S92', '4').
Click the matching route in the suggestion list.
Click 'Select routes' if needed.
Click the 'Select Date' box and pick a date, using 'Next Month' to navigate if needed.
Read the results panel.

instances.values: Route S92 typed and selected, date left at default 04/07/2023.
Route '4' typed and selected, date changed from 04/12/2023 to May 3 2023 via calendar.

opportunities.name: SpotHero airport parking search by airport and dates
opportunities.description: Search parking near an airport on SpotHero by selecting the airport from the Airport tab, optionally setting parking dates, and sorting results.
steps: Open SpotHero and click the 'Airport' tab.
Click the 'Airport Name, Code or City' search box and type the airport name or code.
Click the matching airport in the suggestion list.
Click 'Parking Start Date' and click the start date; then click 'Parking End Date' and click the end date.
Click 'Search'.
Optionally change the 'Featured' sort dropdown.

instances.values: JFK typed and selected, start Apr 18, end Apr 20 2023, sort set to 'Shuttle Time'.
Airport tab, 'Dallas Love Field' typed and selected (DAL). Dates not set before the recording moved on.
